metaDescription: Shopify store for Skin Deep, a natural skincare brand: shop by product or skin concern, a build-your-own bundle offer, value kits and mobile-first pages.
summary: Shopify store for a natural skincare, haircare and beauty brand.
overview: Skin Deep sells natural skincare, haircare, lip and body care, with a catalog of close to 70 products and bundles. Pixel2Tech built Skin Deep's Shopify store as white-label development partner for a digital agency, making a large range easy to shop on any screen.
challenge: A skincare range this wide is hard to browse by product name alone. Shoppers usually start from a concern such as acne, dryness or dull skin, and many want a routine rather than a single product.
approach: Navigation lets shoppers browse by category (skincare and beauty, hair care, clinical) or by skin concern. Value bundles group products into routines by concern, and a build-your-own-bundle offer encourages larger orders. Product pages lead with ratings, price and clear tabs for details, how it works, how to use and ingredients.
outcome: A Shopify store where shoppers can find products by need, compare routines and buy bundles in a few taps, with the same experience on mobile and desktop.

process.title: Catalog and navigation
process.body: Products are organized two ways: by type (skincare and beauty, hair care, clinical) and by skin concern, so shoppers can start from the problem they want to solve.

process.title: Bundles and offers
process.body: Value kits group products into routines by concern, and a build-your-own-bundle offer gives a discount for choosing several products together.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Each product page shows the rating, price and size options up front, with tabs for details, how it works, how to use and ingredients.

process.title: Mobile first
process.body: Menus, collection grids and product pages are laid out for phones first, where most beauty shoppers browse and buy.

whyItMatters: In skincare, shoppers buy for a concern and come back for a routine. A store that lets them shop by need and buy bundled routines makes the first order easier and the next one more likely.

faqs.q: What platform is the Skin Deep store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Dawn theme (Online Store 2.0), using Shopify collections for categories, skin concerns and value bundles.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build Shopify stores and websites under the agency's brand, so the agency stays the face to its client, and we sign an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
